evidenceBasedConclusions.evidence: The Bureau of Justice Assistance, a component under the Department of Justice’s Office of Justice Programs, awarded almost $290 million to support state, local, and tribal governments in criminal justice activities to keep American communities safe. Of this amount, more than $4 million has been awarded to agencies in the Northern District of Ohio including in Akron, Cleveland, Canton, Lima, Lorain, Toledo, Warren, Youngstown, Lake County, and Mahoning County. This current source item can be tested against the underlying record and connected to the relevant evidence lane.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
evidenceBasedConclusions.alternativeInterpretation: The record may have a narrower legal or factual meaning than the surrounding public narrative suggests.
